rationale: The buyer is well-defined — Salesforce admins and developers at mid-to-enterprise companies managing compliance-sensitive approval workflows — and this segment demonstrably pays for AppExchange solutions, often in the $1,000–$10,000/year range. The pain is real: broken mandatory-comment flows create audit trail gaps in business-critical processes. However, buildability_with_ai scores 3 because a proper solution requires Salesforce platform expertise, Apex/Flow development, AppExchange security review certification, and ongoing compatibility maintenance across Salesforce releases — none of which are achievable with Claude prompts and a landing page. Operational_autonomy also falls short (4) since AppExchange ISV products require developer-level maintenance. Both critical build gates (buildability_with_ai min 6, operational_autonomy min 7) fail, so the stage is capped at validate despite a borderline total.
solution_plan: What it is: a Salesforce AppExchange micro-app that enforces mandatory rejection comments natively in any approval process, without brittle custom flows. The core problem is genuine and the market is proven — but this is not buildable by a solo non-technical operator using Claude + a landing page. Building even a minimal Salesforce managed package requires Apex code, Flow metadata, a Salesforce Partner account, passing AppExchange Security Review (a multi-week process), and ongoing compatibility updates with each Salesforce seasonal release. Claude can help draft the Apex logic and documentation, but a Salesforce-credentialed developer is needed to actually build, test, and certify the package. If Youval has access to a Salesforce developer partner, this could be validated first by posting in the Salesforce Trailblazer Community to gauge demand; only proceed to build with a technical co-builder. Otherwise, recommend dropping this specific execution path in favor of an opportunity the factory can build autonomously.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai build gate (score 3, floor 6) and operational_autonomy build gate (score 4, floor 7). Salesforce AppExchange requires certified managed packages — not achievable with standard Claude factory tooling alone. Validate demand first; only build with a Salesforce-credentialed developer.
